note: Re-judged against RFC 4271 Section 9.2.2.2: "ATOMIC_AGGREGATE: If at least one of the routes to be aggregated has ATOMIC_AGGREGATE path attribute, then the aggregated route SHALL have this attribute as well." TestRFC4271RouteAggregationNextHopAtomicAndAggregator isolates contributor ATOMIC_AGGREGATE inheritance by holding contributor AS_PATHs identical ([65010]), proving absence of AttrAtomicAggregate on BestChange and update-text when no contributor carries it (negative), and exact count 1 with length 0 on BestChange wire bytes plus `atomic-aggregate` in the dispatched update-text command when one contributor carries it (positive). ParseUpdateText encodes atomic-aggregate into batch.Wire which planBatchAttrs preserves on wire UPDATEs. Both positive and negative discrimination records in rfc/discrimination/rfc4271/RFC4271-9.2.2.2-4.json are current (producer-disable revert records).
upgrade_reason: Updated aggregate.go and TestRFC4271RouteAggregationNextHopAtomicAndAggregator now dispatch peer update-text commands and assert wire AttrAtomicAggregate count (0 vs 1) with exact RFC 4271 Section 4.3 length 0 on BestChange.Attributes plus presence/absence of atomic-aggregate in dispatched update-text commands under identical contributor AS_PATHs.
